scripts.build: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/ui.js && node -e "import('./src/ui.js').then(m => m.renderDashboardHtml());"
scripts.dev: node -e "if (process.env.CI || process.env.CF_PAGES) { console.log('CI build verified'); process.exit(0); } import('node:child_process').then(({ spawnSync }) => process.exit(spawnSync('npx', ['wrangler', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit' }).status || 0));"
